description: Move a file into a folder, by folderId or by folderPath (missing folders are created). For a Latest-uploads file this is also "Keep" — it stops expiring and starts counting toward storage. Filing convention: a document about one person goes under that person first ("Alva/Vaccination"); anything else topic first ("Sports/Football/Rules"). At most 3 levels; existing folders are reused by name, missing ones are created.

folderPath.description: Destination path like "Alva/Vaccination"; use instead of folderId, never both

name: move_file
title: Move file (or Keep)
